To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the proposed features are able to detect fake reviews in a review-site, with good performance, in particular for singleton fake reviews.

1) a set of features that are useful to discriminate fake and genuine reviews has been identified and proposed, by considering both review- and reviewer-related characteristics, and by considering both well known and new features; 2) these features have been evaluated by implementing a Random Forests classifier, by considering a large-scale labeled data-set; 3) the proposed features are able to discriminate fake reviews with good performance, in particular singleton fake ones.
the proposed new features, together with some of the most used features, allow to obtain a very accurate classifier for detecting fake reviews, in comparison with the state of the art.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following aspects: • We propose a feature analysis for fake review detection, by considering both reviewer- and review-centric characteristics, as well as network-based features.
the following research question: “Which features can be used for fake review detection?”

i) the analysis of the main features proposed in literature for the detection of fake reviews in the last years; ii) the definition and the evaluation of some additional new features, in particular for singleton fake reviews, which can be useful to detect fake reviews; iii) the implementation of a Random Forests classifier, by considering the main well-known features proposed in literature, as well as the new features defined in this study.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
fake review detection is still a hard task, and that more research is needed to improve the state-of-the-art.
fake reviews can be detected by using a large set of features, which should be extracted from both reviews and reviewers.
the more features are used, the more accurate results can be achieved, but at the same time the more time-consuming is the classification process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have provided an analysis of the most common features that have been used in the literature, and we have proposed some new features that can improve the classification of fake reviews.
the proposed features are useful to detect fake reviews and the proposed classifier can achieve high accuracy.
the proposed approach, by considering a large set of features, provides a good performance, in terms of accuracy, in detecting fake reviews.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, in order to detect fake reviews with a supervised approach, it is necessary to consider not only the review content, but also the reviewer profile, as well as the network structure of a review site.
the use of features based on the review text and on the review structure, together with features related to the reviewer, can provide good results in fake review classification.

the features used for the classification are very important and should be carefully selected, and that the use of additional features, such as the ones proposed in this article, can lead to better results.
